data.name: ゼロから始まる終わりの村／The Village of the End Starting from Zero
data.detailed_description:
This is a sandbox slow life x idle game SLG.

This isn't just a relaxing game.

As you progress, you gradually realize that this is a "post-apocalyptic slow life"—a world that has already met its end, yet where life goes on.

That is why it is the Village of the End...! Will you be able to uncover the truth?

◆Contents

Start as Zero and run a book inn while completing errands (quests) to report back to clear stages!

As you complete stages, your romance with the heroine, Ray, will also progress.

While Ray is the only playable character, there are many NPC characters who will ask you to complete quests.

◆ Features

Every 60 seconds, money, stats, and experience points will increase by 1.

After another 5000 seconds, you'll randomly receive valuable crafting materials and your stats will increase.

Although players have HP, they will recover immediately even if they are defeated, making the gameplay less frustrating. However, we want players to live a normal human life.

◆What You Can Do

Village Development/Village Revitalization (Increases as houses and facilities rank up)

Crafting (Cooking/Crafting)

Vegetable Farming (Simple Farming)

Dairy Farming (Simple Feeding)

Fishing (Catching Probability is Quite Severe)

Mining (Examine Stones)

Bug Catching (Prepare Lots of Nets)

Plant Hunting

Mushroom Hunting

Customer Service (Go to the Counter)

Errands (Quests)

Inspect Inn Books (Status Boost)

Book Lending Service: Inn-like Activities (From the Bulletin Board Outside (Image ↑))

Events Triggered by Working or Ignoring the Service

Publishing a Book (Earn Royalties)

Complete item encyclopedia!

There are exactly 400 types of items alone! 71 types of weapons and 100 types of armor!

You can fill up your item encyclopedia by putting in the effort to "explore."

Even if you don't want to fight the golem that appears at the end, you can beat it just by living your life.

◆Guidelines for Reviews, Comments, and Reviews

Posting is OK. In fact, we ask for your support.

When posting on the site, we strictly prohibit any actions intended to tarnish or defame our brand, such as star ratings or rankings.

We have not made any terrible games, so we take no responsibility for them. Please understand this and play at your own risk.

◆ Commentary Guidelines

Please feel free to commentate! It's very welcome.

Monetary commentary is also acceptable. However, please be sure to follow the rules below.

1. Defamation (listening to the negative aspects of the game to make people laugh, streamer comments, and listener comments) is not allowed.

2. Please do not allow children to watch the game or cause any viewers any discomfort.

3. Please include links to the gameplay or purchase sites. Please also include the title of the stream when streaming.

(This is now required to prevent hidden commentary. Thank you for your understanding.)

Appropriate action will be taken against anyone who violates the rules.

We will request deletion and report the user. In some cases, legal action may be considered.

Please be sure to observe common sense and good manners as a human being.

data.short_description: A miniature-world slow-life game meets an idle game! Run an inn inside a book and enjoy bug catching, fishing, farming, and dairy work—plus crafting! Pursue romance with heroines! Live life "from scratch" in a soothing post-apocalyptic world—perfect for playing in your spare moments!
